## Fixes for Schedule I 0.4.7f6

- Opening Settings → Gamepad no longer hangs when a loading dock changes its assigned vehicle and no mod is listening for that event.
- Plain custom NPC contacts no longer crash shortly after a save loads. Both the legacy constructor and `ConfigurePrefab` paths now let native `NPC.Awake` initialize their data once.

## Compatibility and validation

- No public S1API signatures, save identifiers, or network formats changed.
- The two-contact repro stayed in playable gameplay after load on 0.4.7f6 Mono (Steam build 25439857) and IL2CPP (25439817). The Gamepad panel opened on IL2CPP. Both contract suites passed.
- This is a GitHub-only prerelease for the game beta. It does not publish to NuGet, Nexus Mods, or Thunderstore.
- Fixes [issue #314](https://github.com/ifBars/S1API/issues/314) with [PR #316](https://github.com/ifBars/S1API/pull/316), and [issue #315](https://github.com/ifBars/S1API/issues/315) with [PR #317](https://github.com/ifBars/S1API/pull/317).
